messages:
maia-sales: Urgent help needed  BlueRidge POC is blocked. Their serverless demo calls our generate endpoint and gets 403 invalid_org_binding, then a separate attempt returned insufficient_scopes. Kickoff in 30m.

devon-ps: Yikes. Which keys are they using and what client?

maia-sales: They shared a snippet from their serverless function: 
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer sk_trial_BR01',
    'X-Redwood-Org': 'org-blueridge-prod',
    'X-Redwood-Project': 'proj-data-ingest'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hello' })
})
```
They said they reused headers from prod and assumed the trial key would work the same.

tara-eng: That explains the 403 if the key is org-bound to a different org or project. Also suspicious about insufficient_scopes if the key only has embed or read-only scope. Can ops inspect the key metadata?

leo-ops: Running key inspect now: `redwood keys inspect sk_trial_BR01` -> {"key":"sk_trial_BR01","org_id":"org-blueridge-demo","project_id":"proj-demo-1","scopes":["embed"],"bound":true} (inspected by leo-ops).

devon-ps: Ok two issues: 1) bound org/project (org-blueridge-demo / proj-demo-1) doesn't match headers they sent (org-blueridge-prod / proj-data-ingest) -> invalid_org_binding. 2) key only has embed scope, so generate calls trigger insufficient_scopes.

maia-sales: Customer wants the path of least resistance  they prefer a quick key we can hand them so the demo runs without code edits. Is that safe?

tara-eng: For server-side demos we can create a project-scoped key that has both generate+embed and bind it to their demo project (proj-data-ingest) OR issue a short-lived unbound key. Best practice: prefer a project-scoped key bound to the demo project for isolation and least privilege.

leo-ops: I can create a project-scoped temporary key `sk_temp_br_demo` bound to org-blueridge-demo but with project_id=proj-data-ingest and scopes ["generate","embed"], TTL 90m. Ops approval needed.

devon-ps: Approving. Please also log audit and include audit id for the security questionnaire (they asked for SC-03 evidence).

redwood-bot: Action: creating temporary project-scoped key. Requested by devon-ps.

leo-ops: Created key: sk_temp_br_demo (expires in 5400s)  bound to org: org-blueridge-demo  project: proj-data-ingest  scopes: [generate, embed]  audit_id: audit_2160004410_br

maia-sales: Pasting to customer now. They said the 403 is gone but when they ran a script with 60 concurrent generate calls they hit a few 429s. Any quick mitigations?

tara-eng: Demo keys and project-bound keys have conservative concurrency by default. For immediate relief: recommend client-side retry with exponential backoff + full jitter, base 120ms, max 4 retries. Example snippet we can share. Also ops can temporarily raise soft concurrency for their demo project if you want zero friction.

leo-ops: I bumped soft concurrency for proj-data-ingest to 70 for 60m and set an alert to revert. Audit note added: audit_2160004425_concurrency.

redwood-bot: Action: concurrency increased for project proj-data-ingest (60m). Audit recorded: audit_2160004425_concurrency.

maia-sales: Customer reran load and saw 429s drop to near-zero. They asked two follow-ups: 1) how to inspect a key themselves to see scopes and binding, 2) what's our policy on demo key billing.

devon-ps: Tell them CLI command: `redwood keys inspect <key>` which returns JSON with org_id, project_id, scopes, bound flag. For billing: demo windows are not billed for ad-hoc demo bursts; production usage is charged per-token and by reserved capacity in Dedicated. Pricing team will follow up for extended trials.

tara-eng: I'll also draft a short blurb for SC-03/SC-04: "Demo keys are short-lived and can be project- or org-bound and scoped to specific endpoints. Temporary project-scoped keys are issued with Ops approval and logged; audit exports are provided for compliance. Production keys should be bound and rotated per policy." Want me to paste that into the questionnaire?

leo-ops: Exported audit for sk_temp_br_demo and attached to the questionnaire. Audit id: audit_2160004410_br. Key will auto-expire.

maia-sales: Customer confirmed POC completed and latency looked great. They requested a pricing follow-up for a performance evaluation next month. I'll open a separate thread for pricing. Closing this one unless they re-open. :white_check_mark:
